notes: Each occurrence has an exact position in the immutable archived OCR. The relevant original printed PDF page has not been certified.
One repeats Psalm 25:8 in the same chapter: count as a second textual occurrence, not a different verse.
1 Thessalonians 5:27 uses an unusual split book-and-verse form; the book name is unambiguously in immediately preceding prose.
John 19:19 is a prooftext used in a historically insecure speculation about the precise form of the Cross; do not adopt it as established history.
Hebrews 11:4 is relevant to Abel in the Supra quae; extend FRG41 rather than duplicate it.

The four newly unique passages were independently cross-referenced with online Douay-Rheims 1899 verse content; repeated Psalm 25:8 relies on earlier independent Psalm-25 checks. These are Bible-text witnesses, not proofs of Lanslots page images.
